sections.title: Form and leaves
sections.text: Plantago media, hoary plantain, is a perennial rosette herb, usually 15–50 cm tall. Its soft, hairy, elliptic leaves have prominent parallel veins.

sections.title: Flowers and seeds
sections.text: Dense cylindrical spikes bear small whitish to pinkish flowers with conspicuous projecting stamens. Each 2.5–4 mm capsule contains two to four seeds.
